text:
maria: Observed another EU-West wave around 10:45 where a bunch of WS clients go quiet for ~30s then all reconnect. Dashboard spike in active_conns, then drop. Not normal TTL churn.

maria: quick proxy snippet for conn=cn_a12b:
```
[2026-03-21T10:45:10Z] upstream=edge-eu route=v2-canary conn=cn_a12b reattach->proxy
[2026-03-21T10:45:11Z] proxy: lookup session tok=tok_xyz -> missing
[2026-03-21T10:45:11Z] proxy: respond 204 to REATTACH for conn=cn_a12b
[2026-03-21T10:45:42Z] client-side reconnect new_conn=cn_a12b_1
```

jack: headers for the session? any x-route headers?

maria: headers: `x-routing-hint: eu-west-2a`, `x-route-version: v2-canary`, `x-client-keepalive: 15s`.

sophie: telemetry: we see `proxy.reattach_204` delta up at 10:45 and `conn.last_frame_received` gap across many sockets. Also p99 last_frame_received_seconds jumped from 3s->40s for that route shard.

anshu: billing impact? if session_resume charge fires on reconnect we could bill twice if resume not deduped.

maria: confirmed: billing log shows resume charge for tok_xyz at 10:45:12 and again at 10:45:43.

rachel: we recently flipped the console fast-failover flag in eu-west at 10:42 as part of canary. Could be midflight route swapping active sockets.

jack: likely cause: proxy transitions route ownership and responds 204 for REATTACH instead of proxying/410. Client fallbacks -> full reconnect. If reconnects are fast we double-count usage.

oliver: I'm pausing the canary weight ramp now and disabling fast-failover. Deploy-bot, pause job?

deploy-bot: pausing canary ramp and toggling fast-failover off 1: job #deploy-9240 triggered.

maria: mitigation verified: after rollback active connections stabilized within ~120s.

jack: short-term fixes: 1) console rollback (done), 2) client SDK should jitter reconnect between 500ms-3s, 3) billing guard to dedupe resume events for a 10s sliding window.

anshu: opening quick billing patch PR to dedupe by resume-token + route + 10s window. That should prevent double charges during storms.

sophie: I'll add a Grafana panel for `conn.last_frame_received_seconds` by route and an alert when p99 > 10s AND `proxy.reattach_204` rate > 5/min. Also add a sample exporter to capture traces for sockets that gap > 20s.

jack: long-term: we need reattach idempotency across proxies (RFC: reattach-v2), explicit proxy response codes: return 410 for session-not-found on reattach instead of 204 so client can decide to reconnect with backoff, and a route-swap drain window (honor existing sessions for N seconds).

oliver: console UX follow-up: show a red warning when changing routing weight that active streaming connections may be affected + add single-click rollback. I'll make a mock in product.

maria: INFRA ticket INFRA-3289 created with repro script and logs. repro script: `./scripts/repro/ws-midflight-reattach.sh --region eu-west --weight 60 --concurrency 300`.

jack: assigning reattach idempotency work to eng-runtime. I'll draft the proxy semantics change (204->410) and a compatibility plan.

anshu: billing guard PR submitted, will monitor staging.

sophie: created dashboard panel and alert, linking: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/streaming/reattach-alerts

maria: thanks all. We should run a postmortem once INFRA-3289 has the timeline and RCA. For now keeping rollback until reattach semantics are patched. :thumbsup:
